adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` the diff removes the documented `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` and all logic using `options[:category]`, so `thor disqus:import -c Foo` would now raise an unknown-option error. It also replaces `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), category: category_id)` with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and `TopicEmbed.import/_remote` does not propagate `created_at` or category, so re-imported topics will lose original timestamps and category placement. Additionally, `TopicEmbed.import` returns nil unless the URL matches `^https?://`, so non-http(s) thread links that previously created a topic will now result in no topic being created (though fetch failures would more likely raise from `open(url)` rather than being silently ignored).
